They're friendly. They're not on your side.

The adjuster's job is to close your Baldwin Park claim cheap. It's not a conspiracy. It's the business.

  • They'll ask for a recorded statement while you're still on pain medication.
  • They'll offer money before anyone knows whether you need an MRI.
  • If you wait to see a doctor, they'll say you “weren't that hurt.”
  • They'll say you were partly at fault to trim the check. California's comparative fault lets them try. You don't have to accept their percentage.

You don't need to become an expert in that playbook while your body is trying to heal. That's what you hire us for.

The recorded statement

Everything you say gets used. Don't give one.

The first offer

It's sized for someone without a lawyer.

The treatment gap

Waiting “to see if it goes away” becomes their argument.

Shared fault

California lets you recover even if you were partly at fault. Don't sign their version.

Waiting is the most expensive thing you can do.

California generally gives you two years from the crash to sue. If the crash involves the city, the county, or a transit agency, you may have only six months to file a government claim. Miss it and the case can die no matter how badly you were hurt.

The clock that actually kills cases is faster than the law:

  • Store and freeway cameras overwrite in days
  • Witnesses stop answering
  • The other driver “remembers” a different story after talking to their insurer
  • You wait to see a doctor, and they call that a gap

Call now. If there's no case, we'll tell you. If there is, we send the letters to preserve the video while it still exists.

What everyone asks

What does it cost?
Nothing up front. No attorney fee unless we recover. Case costs are explained before you sign.
They already offered me a check.
Don't cash it. The first offer is sized for someone who doesn't have a lawyer yet. Free case review. If the check was fair, we'll tell you. It almost never is.
I was partly at fault.
You can still have a claim. In California, comparative fault reduces what you collect — it doesn't erase it. Don't accept the adjuster's percentage.
Will I have to go to court?
Most cases settle. We prepare as if they won't. That's why the number moves.
I don't have papers / I didn't go to the ER / I don't speak English.
Call anyway. California law doesn't take away your claim because of immigration status. If you didn't see a doctor the same day, there's still a case — waiting longer makes it worse. And you don't need English: Ismael is on the team.
